hsa.healthcare_need.source: Fidelity 2026 Retiree Health Care Cost Estimate: about $185,500 per 65-year-old retiring in 2026, after tax, lifetime; excludes long-term care and most dental. A couple is twice the single figure (Fidelity's 2025 edition: $172,500 single, $345,000 couple). Reported by secondary sources; re-check against fidelity.com each year.

ltc.cost_of_care.source: Genworth/CareScout 2024 Cost of Care Survey (released March 2025): national median annual cost, home health aide $77,792 (44 h/week), assisted living $70,800, nursing home semi-private $111,325, private $127,750. Probabilities: HHS ASPE, about 70% of people who reach 65 develop severe long-term care needs and 48% receive some paid care; ACL: care averages about 3 years. Prices reported via press coverage of the survey (secondary); re-check against Genworth/CareScout each year.
